description: Defines classes, structs, and functions for aggregating and managing RRC (Radio Resource Control) connection metrics within the ocudu::ocucp namespace, including connection establishment, reestablishment, and resume metrics, with time-based analysis.

classes.name: rrc_du_metrics_aggregator
classes.description: Main class for collecting and aggregating RRC connection metrics, including methods for updating metrics and calculating statistical measures like mean and maximum number of RRC connections.

classes.name: rrc_connection_metrics_aggregator
classes.description: Nested struct within rrc_du_metrics_aggregator that manages time-series data of RRC connections, providing methods to add/remove connections and compute statistical metrics.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_rrc_setup
methods.description: Records a successful RRC setup event.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_rrc_release
methods.description: Records a successful RRC release event, optionally marking it as inactive.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_rrc_inactive
methods.description: Records a successful RRC inactive event.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_rrc_resume
methods.description: Records a successful RRC resume event.

methods.name: aggregate_attempted_connection_establishment
methods.description: Records an attempted connection establishment with a specific cause.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_connection_establishment
methods.description: Records a successful connection establishment with a specific cause.

methods.name: aggregate_attempted_connection_reestablishment
methods.description: Records an attempt to reestablish a connection.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_connection_reestablishment
methods.description: Records a successful connection reestablishment, indicating if it included UE context.

methods.name: aggregate_attempted_connection_resume
methods.description: Records an attempt to resume a connection with a specific cause.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_connection_resume
methods.description: Records a successful connection resume with a specific cause.

methods.name: aggregate_successful_connection_resume_with_fallback
methods.description: Records a successful connection resume with fallback, with a specific cause.

methods.name: aggregate_connection_resume_followed_by_network_release
methods.description: Records a connection resume followed by network release, with a specific cause.

methods.name: aggregate_attempted_connection_resume_followed_by_rrc_setup
methods.description: Records an attempt to resume connection followed by RRC setup, with a specific cause.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects and outputs current metrics into provided rrc_du_metrics structure.
